description:
Add the type-erased/runtime code handle layer over the generic traits so exploratory workflows can hold heterogeneous codes without naming their field types.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A type-erased handle wraps any static generic code and exposes the shared trait operations, reporting dynamic field/type mismatches through the coding-general error layer.
- [hard] REQ-02: A doctest-backed example demonstrates an exploratory flow constructing and encoding through the erased handle.
title: Add runtime type-erased code handles for exploratory workflows
